verdict.rationale: Yubico's docs establish the YubiKey as a FIDO2/WebAuthn passkey and phishing-resistant MFA device for online accounts and services, and community users confirm FIDO2/WebAuthn support and enrolling one key across many accounts. However, nothing in the pack names the specific services the story asks about or confirms they work. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of compatibility with Google, GitHub, Microsoft and password managers; explicit U2F/CTAP1 legacy support; independent hands-on reports of cross-service use.
